reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: This is my third order. I love that this does not require hours of having a mask on and still see its effects. The jelly mask material makes it feel refreshing too.
reviews.zh: 已經係第三次回購。我好鍾意佢唔使敷好耐已經見到效果。果凍面膜質地敷上去好清爽。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: Очень люблю гидрогелевые маски и эта одна из самых любимых,у меня аллергическая кожа с красными щеками,она отлично мне подходит ,охлаждает и снимает покраснения
reviews.zh: 我非常鍾意水凝膠面膜，呢款係我最鍾意嘅之一。我有過敏性皮膚，面頰容易泛紅，佢非常適合我，涼爽之餘仲可以紓緩泛紅。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text:
I first got these in the 2025 advent calendar and was so surprised at how much I loved them! They’re a pretty pink colour rather than the usual white and fit my face better than most other gel masks I have tried. I usually leave them on for about an hour or two and by that time patches on the mask have started to turn clear, but haven’t felt drying. My skin afterwards looks so plump and glowing and feels lovely to touch. My skin also looks better the day after using these. 
I finished the box and had to buy more. Then I was so happy to see that OY were giving them away as freebies with orders, that I placed a couple more so that I could build up a stash!
Other than the original sunscreen, I hadn’t tried any Round Lab products before these masks. I’ve since tried the dokdo cleanser (a mini from the calendar) and have just bought a full size double pack! I also got the dokdo gel sheet masks after seeing a review from Soo Beauty on YouTube and they’re fabulous too!
reviews.zh: 我第一次係 2025 advent calendar 接觸到佢哋，估唔到自己會咁鍾意！佢哋係靚靚嘅粉紅色，唔係一般嘅白色，而且比起我試過嘅大部分凝膠面膜更加貼面。我通常敷一兩個鐘，敷到嗰陣面膜有啲位開始變透明，但都唔覺乾。用完之後皮膚睇落飽滿有光澤，觸感好舒服。第二日皮膚狀態仲好過用之前。用完一盒之後要再買。後來見到 OY 隨單送呢款面膜，開心到即刻再落多幾張單，囤多啲貨！除咗佢哋嘅防曬，之前未試過其他 Round Lab 產品。之後我試咗 dokdo 潔面（advent calendar 送嘅細裝），啱啱仲買咗 full size 兩支裝！睇完 YouTube 嘅 Soo Beauty 評價之後，我仲買埋 dokdo 凝膠面膜，勁好用！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: I feel the gel masks are the best if not doing a modeling mask pack. So far, my skin looks and feels great without too much irritation. I have a sensitive skin and this product doesn’t seem to bother my skin in the negative way.
reviews.zh: 如果唔做 modeling mask，呢款凝膠面膜我覺得係最好嘅。暫時用完皮膚狀態好咗，亦都冇太大刺激。我係敏感肌，但呢款產品暫時冇對我塊面造成任何負面影響。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text:
As a disclaimer, I have a very dry dehydrated skin. 
This mask is great, it feels cooling and comfortable on the skin and the mask sits well. However, compared to other gel masks, I found this mask to dry sooner.
reviews.zh: 先講聲，我係極乾缺水嘅肌膚。呢款面膜好正，敷上面涼浸浸好舒服，而且貼面程度好好。不過比起其他凝膠面膜，我發覺呢款乾得快啲。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: These masks will always be one of my absolute favorites, it fully absorbs after an hour and a half to 2 hours so it's not cumbersome like others. My skin always looks beautiful after.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜永遠都會係我最鍾意嘅之一，一個半至兩個鐘就可以完全吸收，唔似其他面膜咁麻煩。每次用完皮膚都好好睇。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: This is one of the best gel masks I’ve tried for hydration and firming. It’s especially great for when my skin feels tired or lacks bounce. While it’s a bit pricier than some other sheet masks, the texture, comfort, and results definitely stand out. I would highly recommend it for anyone looking for a pampering, effective skincare treatment that leaves the skin refreshed, hydrated, and looking its best. I’ll definitely be using the rest of the set and considering a repurchase.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我試過嘅凝膠面膜入面，保濕同緊緻效果最好嘅之一。當皮膚攰或者冇彈性嘅時候用特別正。雖然比起其他面膜價錢稍貴，但質地、舒適度同效果都明顯突出。強烈推薦畀想搵一款奢護、有效護膚療程，等皮膚煥然一新、保濕到位、狀態最佳嘅人。一定會用晒成盒，亦會考慮回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: Good mask, better than some of the other famous gel mask. However this mask is a bit too small and the bottom piece doesn’t adhere well and require some self-cutting to fit. Outcome wise is good and feel very supple after 1-2 hours. (Don’t put it on for 20-30 mins as advice by the box)
reviews.zh: 好嘅面膜，比起其他出名嘅凝膠面膜更好。不過呢款有少少細，下半部分貼合度唔夠好，要自己剪過先啱位。效果方面幾好，敷一至兩個鐘之後皮膚好柔軟。（唔好跟盒上面指示咁淨係敷 20-30 分鐘。）

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
